description: Source code for the StreamingSessionActor class, an Akka actor managing individual streaming sessions in an Eclipse Ditto-based gateway service.

classes.name: StreamingSessionActor
classes.description: Akka actor managing a single streaming connection/session, handling message flow, subscription management, acknowledgements, and session lifecycle.

classes.name: Control
classes.description: Enumeration of control messages for actor lifecycle management, e.g., termination.

classes.name: ConfirmSubscription
classes.description: Internal message indicating a successful subscription acknowledgment for a streaming type.

classes.name: ConfirmUnsubscription
classes.description: Internal message indicating a successful unsubscription acknowledgment for a streaming type.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for actor instantiation with necessary dependencies.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initial setup upon actor start, including lifecycle hooks and declaration of acknowledgment labels.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleanup routine upon actor stopping, closing resources and logging.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the main message handling behavior combining different protocol behaviors.

methods.name: createIncomingSignalBehavior
methods.description: Handles incoming signals and commands related to the session, including acknowledgements and searches.

methods.name: createOutgoingSignalBehavior
methods.description: Handles outbound signals, publishing responses or errors, and forwarding signals to command router.

methods.name: createPubSubBehavior
methods.description: Manages start/stop subscription requests, subscription state, and subscription acknowledgements.

methods.name: createSelfTerminationBehavior
methods.description: Manages actor's self-termination conditions, JWT refresh, session timeout, and unsubscriptions.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgment labels cluster-wide to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: determineStreamingType
methods.description: Determines the streaming type (events, messages, commands) based on a signal.

methods.name: parseCriteria
methods.description: Parses a filter string into a Criteria object with associated headers.

methods.name: confirmSubscription
methods.description: Marks a streaming type as acknowledged and sends acknowledgment message.

methods.name: confirmUnsubscription
methods.description: Sends acknowledgment for unsubscription from a streaming type.
